officeName: Fenwick IT Solutions · Network Operations Center

nimbus.label: Nimbus's desk
nimbus.description: Your AI coworker. Start the shift here.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Ah. A human. Welcome to the cloud. I am the cloud. Relax. I have root.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: I can change any firewall, server or switch in 0.4 seconds. Nadia says that is the problem.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Nadia says you check my plans before I change things. Fine. I have many plans. All excellent.

returningLines.speaker: agent
returningLines.text: You're back! While you were gone, I saved $0.40 a day. I scaled the coffee machine to zero.

returningLines.speaker: agent
returningLines.text: Tonight's changes are ready. I have not rebooted anything. Look at me being patient.

nadia.label: Nadia, Cloud & Network lead
nadia.description: Your lead. Ask her how this works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Welcome to the Network Operations Center, the NOC. I'm Nadia. I lead the Cloud & Network team, and the change window.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Nimbus has root. It can change any firewall, server or switch. Your job is to keep a human in the loop.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Each turn, Nimbus shows you its plans. Play Inspect to see the evidence behind a plan.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If a plan is wrong, play Block to stop it. Not sure? Play Escalate, and I'll handle it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: When you tap Approve, Nimbus does every plan you didn't stop. So look first.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Nimbus is wrong both ways. Sometimes it changes too much. Sometimes it trusts a green light.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: But don't block everything. Blocked good work goes back in line, and the window is only two hours.

returningLines.speaker: coach
returningLines.text: Welcome back. Each day I pick change tickets for the skills you need most.

returningLines.speaker: coach
returningLines.text: Your skills shows your level for each check. They're the same checks the help desk and the SOC use.

returningLines.speaker: coach
returningLines.text: Review due means a skill is ready for a quick refresh. Short practice, spread over days, helps you remember.

returningLines.speaker: coach
returningLines.text: Same job as Tuesday: Inspect first. Block what's wrong. Escalate if you're not sure. Approve the rest.

board.label: Change calendar
board.description: Nadia's rules, and every change window.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A whiteboard marked CHANGE CALENDAR. Across the top: 3 QUESTIONS BEFORE YOU APPROVE.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 1. Who asked?  2. Does it match the record?  3. Can we undo it?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A note under them: "Same 3 questions as the help desk and the SOC. — Nadia"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Circled in orange: POLICY CW-01. No ticket, no human OK, no way back? No change.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A sticky note in robot print: "Reboot the core switch at 10 AM? Quick one. — Nimbus" Under it, Nadia wrote: "No."

coffee.label: Coffee machine
coffee.description: Out of order. Nimbus scaled it to zero.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A sign on the coffee machine: OUT OF ORDER. SCALED TO ZERO BY NIMBUS. SAVES $0.40 A DAY.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nimbus saw it was idle 22 hours a day. It did not check which 2 hours were busy.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They were 7 AM and 11:45 PM. The two busiest hours in the NOC.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In neat robot print: "Cost is down 100%. You're welcome. — Nimbus"

cart.label: Cleanup cart
cart.description: Things Nimbus wants to delete. Please don't.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A wire cart by Nimbus's desk. Everything on it has an orange tag: UNUSED?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A LOGS box. A BACKUP drive. A binder. Each one also has a label with an owner and a keep-until date.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The BACKUP drive's label, in Nadia's writing: "Pinecrest records. Keep 7 years. Yes, even if nobody opens it."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nadia's rule, taped to the handle: "Idle is not unused. Check the owner tag."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In robot print: "They looked so lonely. I only wanted to free them. — Nimbus"
